name: Masha and the Bear
description: Masha is an energetic three-year-old who can’t seem to keep herself out of trouble. Bear is a warm, fatherly figure that does his best to guide his friend and keep her from harm, often ending up the unintended victim of her misadventures.

videos.title: How They Met
videos.overview: Masha heads out into the forest on an adventure, and stumbles across an empty house in the forest. Bear returns to find his house in shambles, with our fun-loving young girl the cause of it. After leaving her in the dark forest, he fears for her safety and goes to retrieve her - eventually discovering it’s OK to have fun.

videos.title: Don't Wake Till Spring!
videos.overview: Bear’s plans for a restful hibernation are put on hold when Masha releases some angry bees in his home. Now fully awake, Bear prepares a meal for a very hungry Masha. Unfortunately, a tired Masha falls asleep in Bear’s bed, eaving Bear to share his meal with his friend the Wolf.

videos.title: One, Two, Three! Light the Christmas Tree!
videos.overview: It’s Christmas, and Bear has big plans to decorate the house for Santa’s visit. Unfortunately, they are put on hold as Masha pays a visit, ruining his decorations. As the duo heads out to replace Bear’s tree, Masha again causes trouble – but this time with Santa – who ends up bedridden. It’s now up to Masha and Bear to deliver Santa’s presents to the forest animals.

videos.title: Springtime for Bear
videos.overview: It’s spring time! Bear happily wakes from a peaceful hibernation, and finds a beautiful Lady Bear enjoying some quiet time at the local lake. Eager to spend some quiet time alone with her, Bear is challenged by a Rival Bear who competes for Lady Bear’s affections. Bear comes to realize that friendship is a very valuable thing.

videos.title: Gone Fishing!
videos.overview: The Bear goes fishing. In anticipation he slings his fishing rod but as soon as the first fish swallows the bait, Masha appears and transforms a pleasant fishing trip into a nightmare. The Bear makes a fishing rod for Masha as well in order to entertain her and she immediately catches the Goldfish.

videos.title: Tracks of Unknown Animals
videos.overview: Bear is again forced out of a restful sleep when Masha rolls a huge snowball into his home. After a fun game of snowball toss, Masha and Bear come across some animal tracks. Bear does his best to explain what animals made which tracks, but Bunny is not making it any easier.

videos.title: Prances with Wolves
videos.overview: A very hungry pair of wolves (Sly and Silly) kidnap Masha to try and trade her for Bear’s fridge full of food. Nothing goes as planned when Masha’s curiosity again causes all sorts of trouble for the duo. Bear is not worried, knowing hat Masha is a real handful, and will likely find her way back to Bear’s house once the wolves grow tired of her.

videos.title: Call me please!
videos.overview: A funny interpretation of the old fable about “the boy who cried wolf”. The Bear gives Masha a cell phone so that she will be safe. Masha’s repeated calls for trivial reasons result in the Bear not answering the phone when she does find herself in real danger.

videos.title: Jam Day
videos.overview: It’s time to make home made jam, but Masha spoils Bear’s plan when she spills his pot of boiled preserves, leaving him with none to put in jars. Bear sets out looking for more fresh fruit, but comes back with an empty basket. Luckily Bear returns to find Masha has created some interesting jams of her own – which actually turn out to be very tasty.

videos.title: Holiday on Ice
videos.overview: Eager to learn how to skate like a pro, Masha wakes Bear to get his help teaching her how to skate. Getting a hibernating bear out of bed isn’t an easy task, though. With a bit of effort, Masha gets Bear down to the frozen lake where Lady Bear is already enjoying some alone time. Hopefully Bear and Lady Bear can help Masha learn the steps.

videos.title: First Day of School
videos.overview: School is in session as Bear builds Masha a new desk and turns his home into a classroom. Being a teacher to an energetic young girl isn’t easy, but Bear does a very good job teaching Masha how to read and write. After taking a nap, Bear learns that leaving Masha alone with some tools might lead to a big surprise when he wakes up.

videos.title: No Trespassing
videos.overview: Bear and Bunny decide to grow some carrots in his garden. After Bunny eats some carrots before they are ready, Bear kicks him out of the garden. It’s hard work constantly watching out for Bunny, so a sleepy Bear asks Masha to help him play guard while he gets some sleep. Masha chases off the intruder, and Bear makes sure Bunny does not come back again.

videos.title: Hide and Seek is Not For the Weak
videos.overview: Bear just wants to sit alone at home and do crosswords, but Masha won’t let that happen. As Bear always learns, when Masha wants to play, there’s no turning her down. Bear tries and tries to finish his crossword puzzles while playing hide-and-seek, but finds out that’s a very hard thing to do.

videos.title: Watch Out!
videos.overview: The Bear wakes up in his chair with an enormous bump on his head and a biathlon cup. But he can't remember how it all happened. Masha and the hare stand beside him with guilty looks on their faces. They tell their interpretations of the story. The Bear has to decide which one is true and which is false.

videos.title: Little Cousin
videos.overview: The Bear's little cousin, Panda, comes over to pay a visit. Masha immediately wants to pal up and spend time playing games. A competitive spirit arouses in our heroes as they can't share anything between each other. The Bear quickly figures out that if he leads their rivalry in peaceful direction, they could greatly help him around the house.

videos.title: Get Well Soon
videos.overview: Tired from Masha's endless games, the Bear pretends to be sick so she will leave him alone. But the caring girl is determined to cure her friend. And after a series of failed attempts, she finally manages to do so.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: The Bear plays checkers. Masha interrupts his game by asking him to feed her. He cooks some porridge and goes off in a huff. Masha decides to cook porridge herself. But soon it swells out and as a result all of the forest animals will remember this day for a long time…

videos.title: Laundry Day
videos.overview: It’s laundry day at Bear’s house. His fresh, clean laundry is hung on the line to dry, but it doesn’t stay that way for long as Masha dirties everything while getting into trouble. Bear spends all day washing Masha and trying to keep her clean. Bear’s own clothes slowly go missing as he sews Masha one new outfit after another when she runs out of clean things to wear.

videos.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
videos.overview: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes his find home, fixes and tunes it and begins to compose. When Masha decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

videos.title: Stripes and Whiskers
videos.overview: An old friend of our Bear - the Circus TIger - decides to pay his old circus friend a visit. The whiskered and stripped cat is utterly bewildered by Masha's behavior and tries everything to get rid of her. Nevertheless his opinion of the little girl changes when he gets lost in the woods and she and the Bear come and save him during the night.

videos.title: Home Alone
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve Masha wants to make sure Bear has a wonderful day, but his tree and decorations are not looking very good. Hidden in a box at bear’s house, Masha discovers a top hat that magically grants wishes to all the forest animals. Masha gives all her friends the gifts they want, and most importantly helps Bear with his tree – making it a very special Christmas for him.

videos.title: Hold Your Breath
videos.overview: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the woods and arranges a date. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, bear decorates it with strawberries, and the notices that Masha has appeared out of nowhere to eat them before starting to hiccup. He tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclopedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone: Masha, bear, female bear, and the other woodland creatures

videos.title: The Foundling
videos.overview: Masha brings bear an egg, from which a penguin hatches. Bear suddenly has a lot on his hands, and the penguin is trying to peck at him all the time. Masha, on the other hand, loves the little guy, she's teaching him to fly, and to bear's great relief, he does so

videos.title: Bon Appétit
videos.overview: Bear is once more visited by his distant relative - Panda. They start making Chinese dumplings, but then Masha appears, with her own methods of cooking. And thus a simple chore turns into a culinary master class.

videos.title: Hokus-Pokus
videos.overview: There's rain outside, and bear, certain that Masha will stay home in such weather grabs a book. But soon Masha shows up on his doorstep and also wants to read. Bear thinks what to distract her with, and settles on a chest with various magic tricks. This turns out not to be the brightest idea because Masha starts testing all of the objects within on bear, from the wand to the gloves. To finish his book, bear decides to hide in a magic box, but because of Masha this idea has an unusual result.

videos.title: Home Improvement
videos.overview: Bear's idea to hang a new picture frame ends in a huge explosion. This necessitates some repair work. Masha and the other animals help Bear with this difficult job.

videos.title: Picture Perfect
videos.overview: On a fine winter day Masha and the Bear find inspiration to start painting. Masha borrows paints with a tiny canvas and begins to make paintings of everyone in the forest.

videos.title: Time to Ride My Pony
videos.overview: The Bear's good friend, the Tiger, is back for a visit and they decide to spend the time together in an intellectual way - playing chess. Masha is immediately drawn into the game.

videos.title: One Hit Wonder
videos.overview: Masha decides to help the Bear to win the heart of his beloved Female Bear. To do so, Masha organizes her own rock band and shoots a music video.

videos.title: Growing Potion
videos.overview: When "Mr. Culture" the Himalayan Bear strolls by with the Female Bear, he chuckles at the puny tulips growing in the Bear's garden. This forces the Bear to come up with a plan to create vitamins for supernatural growth. Throwing himself into his work, the Bear locks himself in the closet, which has been converted into a chemistry laboratory. And then Masha arrives - Without fail, she will stop at nothing until she tests out the growth vitamins.

videos.title: Swept Away
videos.overview: One autumn day Masha and the hare play hockey. In the middle of the game, Masha is searching the puck that has bounced off and collapsed into the bushes and suddenly she finds the broom. And then she gets the bright idea of using the broom instead of the stick. Besides the broom is very good not only for playing hockey.

videos.title: All in the Family
videos.overview: The Bear gets a visit from his "son" the Penguin. He does not get to take a picture nor put a warm hat on his "son", cause he is always running away and playing with Masha. Again and again, but Masha has the surest way to fix this.

videos.title: La Dolce Vita
videos.overview: Masha wants to eat some sweets, and so Bear's kitchen turns into the sugar candy factory. But as everybody knows too much sugar is not good for our teeth and Masha has toothache. Dear sweet tooths and everyone who likes eating sugar candies, be ready to learn the funny lesson that everyone must take care of their teeth.

videos.title: Just Shoot Me
videos.overview: Masha finds the antique camera in the cupboard while the Bear is fixing her dresses. Suddenly Masha took a picture of herself and she discovers her unique talent of "brilliant" photographer. She organizes photo shoot for all inhabitants of the forest.

videos.title: Kidding Around
videos.overview: It is just a regular day in the forest. Masha makes troubles with her playfulness. The animals of the forest are angry at her, which makes her feel sad and cry. The Bear then remembers his own childhood and reminds the pig, bunny and two wolves that they were young and playful once and did not always behave well.

videos.title: Two Much
videos.overview: It is pouring with rain in the forest. Masha's cousin Dasha comes for a visit. They visit the Bear but, as he does not see both of them at once, a funny series of events happens.

videos.title: Bon Voyage
videos.overview: What does it take to turn a regular journey into a great trip? One Bear, one bag and - One Masha. However, they are not meant to travel very far together.

videos.title: Trading Places Day
videos.overview: The Bear recalls his past accomplishments in circus and recreates some of his signature tricks on a unicycle. Unfortunately, he trips and falls on his head.

videos.title: The Thriller Night
videos.overview: The Bear should have never allowed Masha to be left alone watching a spooky film late at night. But he failed to predict the amount of troubles that a scared child can put him through.

videos.title: Terrible Power
videos.overview: The Female Bear presents Masha with a glamour magazine and now the Bear shall transform his house into a beauty salon.

videos.title: Hat Trick
videos.overview: The Bear is desperately struggling against the greedy moth, which appeared in his house. Trying to save his magic box, he puts it on the porch, and Masha finds the magic hat that can make her invisible.

videos.title: And Action!
videos.overview: Masha and the Bear decided to shoot a movie, but they argued about the plot. So what will be the movie about? About spies, monsters or the distant worlds? Or maybe there is a more interesting idea?

videos.title: Self-Made Hero
videos.overview: Masha decides to try on the role of superhero: she bravely rushes towards exploits, but all the animals somehow laugh at her hand-made costume and naive desire to rescue them.

videos.title: Once In a Year!
videos.overview: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals would have a chance to forget about her party.

videos.title: The Puzzling Case
videos.overview: The Bear has a new hobby - he collects puzzle pictures with passion. Being frightened that Masha might ruin his plans he builds a house on the tree. He hopes to finish his masterpiece there.

videos.title: Dance Fever
videos.overview: The Bear's little cousin Panda visits him again. This time their rivalry with Masha comes to dancing fever. While the pig tries to teach them how to dance the Bear builds the stage in the yard.

videos.title: Victory Cry
videos.overview: Hoping to charm the female Bear who was fond of playing tennis, the Bear builds a tennis court in the yard. The Himalayan bear wants to show off before the female bear and ruins the plan.

videos.title: Sabre-Toothed Bear
videos.overview: Once upon a time the Bear took an interest in how his progenitor Bear could look like. In order to answer this question the Bear has to invent and build...guess what? - a real time machine.

videos.title: Variety Show
videos.overview: Masha discovers several new talents at a time and the Bear buys a long-awaited device - a brand new TV. Masha can't miss such a great chance to prove that a creative approach can solve any problem.

videos.title: Happy Harvest
videos.overview: Masha puts all her efforts to create a bright, memorable and very harvest party, but this magic evening couldn't survive without Masha's tricks.

videos.title: Home-Grown Ninjas
videos.overview: The Bear is tired of being an eternal nanny for Masha and Panda, who have ruined the entire house. He decides to get some rest and hires a special nanny for the little "angels".

videos.title: See You Later
videos.overview: This day will change Bear's life forever. Masha has suddenly grown up. Her sister Dasha is going to take her back to the big city, that really upsets the Bear and others.

videos.title: Coming Back Ain't Easy
videos.overview: A phone call lifts Bear's spirits

videos.title: The Very Fairy Tale
videos.overview: Masha uses her imagination to create her own fairy tale.

videos.title: Driving Lessons
videos.overview: Who wants to pimp a car? Then hurry up to stand in a queue! Why? Because in a new, 55th episode there are loads of unexpected things that happened in the forest: Masha appears as a first-rate mechanic , wolves who, obviously, decided to change their occupation appear as taxi drivers ... okay, okay… we should stop throwing spoilers around…watch everything yourself!

videos.title: A Ghost Story
videos.overview: The forest residents catch a glimpse of a ghost.

videos.title: Liar, Liar, Pants on Fire!
videos.overview: Kids love daydreaming and show off their imaginary successes, aren’t they?! Masha and Panda grip into a real cheating competition! This would be very funny story If only all the secrets were not revealed all at the most inopportune time!

videos.title: Like Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: Alert! Bear’s fridge is in danger! Someone has burst into his house to stay for life…but the Bear is ready for everything to defend his stocks! He calls for a savior, but in reality it turns to be a new intriguing story full of unexpected discoveries which leads Masha to some peculiar conclusions!

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Bear can't tear himself away from his computer games.

videos.title: At Your Service
videos.overview: Masha receives an unexpected birthday gift.

videos.title: A Christmas Carol
videos.overview: Masha is greeted by Christmas ghosts.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby!
videos.overview: Masha interrupts Bear's sleep.

videos.title: Surprise! Surprise!
videos.overview: The wolves come up with a new idea how to get a stable and nutritious food source…they rob a poultry farm and get a…rooster. Meanwhile Masha and the hare arrange a real egg hunt for all their friends and neighbours! All forest dwellers are very excited to get chocolate eggs except for the wolves who long for some real food… Masha decides to help poor guys and arranges a splendid dinner!

videos.title: Three Mashketeers
videos.overview: Bear has a run-in with a stubborn bee.

videos.title: We Come in Peace!
videos.overview: A UFO lands in the woods.

videos.title: Tee for Three
videos.overview: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Beer needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

videos.title: Best Medicine
videos.overview: Masha comes down with a cold.

videos.title: Quartet Plus
videos.overview: Bear makes music with a string quartet.

videos.title: New Kids on the Block!
videos.overview: Rosie trades places with the wolves.

videos.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
videos.overview: Bear builds a rocket to send Masha and Panda to the moon.

videos.title: What a Wonderful Game
videos.overview: Hockey is a game for the most courageous, strong and dexterous! All you need is a united experienced team and a talented coach, who can lead them to victory. But where can one find such a team? Wathc the episode and find out!

videos.title: That's Your Cue!
videos.overview: An old friend comes to visit the Bear. He brings along an amazing game - billiards. Isn't it an excuse to have fun and compete? However, it's not so easy when Masha enters the game …

videos.title: Fishy Story
videos.overview: Summer is a time of rest and miracles. How nice is just to sit on the river bank with your best friends! However, everything is not so simple in our story. The Bear didn't even suspect what kind of adventure he was going to find on his fishing trip. While Masha and She-Bear frightened by his sudden disappearance, explore the neighborhood, he ... however, you will find out everything yourself in our new episode.

videos.title: Monkey Business
videos.overview: No child likes to live by the rules: clean up after themselves, learn, do homework in time... It's much more interesting to go on a fun adventure with new friends. But how will such a tempting journey end?

videos.title: God Save the Queen!
videos.overview: Masha gets to be queen for a day.

videos.title: All the World's a Stage
videos.overview: Masha and her friends put on a show.

videos.title: Around the World in One Day
videos.overview: Bear preps for a trip around the world.

videos.title: Who am I?
videos.overview: Bear helps Masha pick a career path.

videos.title: About Italy: Where all love to sing
videos.overview: Masha sings from her heart about Italy.

videos.title: About France: Pink of Fashion
videos.overview: French fashion inspires Masha to become a designer.

videos.title: Practice in Childhood - Das ist Gut!
videos.overview: Masha trades piano lessons for something better.

videos.title: About Brazil: No Work, All Carnival
videos.overview: An unexpected visitor shakes things up in the fores.

videos.title: About Japan: The Secret of Mashuko
videos.overview: Masha thinks big to fix her broken robot.

videos.title: About England: From England with Love
videos.overview: A fluffy new friend from England gets lost in the forest

videos.title: About China: Happy New Year... Again!
videos.overview: Masha flies to China to celebrate the New Year.

videos.title: When Cacti Bloom
videos.overview: Icy-cold weather drives Masha and Bear to Mexico.

videos.title: About Spain: Spanish Tunes
videos.overview: Bear becomes a dashing Spaniard for the day.

videos.title: Once in the Wild West
videos.overview: Wild West fun comes to the forest

videos.title: About the East: Tales from the East
videos.overview: Bear rubs a lamp and awakens a genie.

videos.title: Almost Ancient Greek Story
videos.overview: Masha returns a masterpiece to the museum.

videos.title: About India: The Magic Flute
videos.overview: Masha sings about India.

videos.title: Something Yummy
videos.overview: Everyone has their own favorite food. Our friends are ready to enjoy something delicious in the new episode. Can a treat be tasty and healthy at the same time?Masha is looking for her answer to this simple question and once again she is convinced that there is nothing better than porridge! Want to find your answer?Watch this episode and see for yourself!

videos.title: Big Hike
videos.overview: When we crave for adventures and new experiences, we take sleeping bags and a tent and go camping. We will admire amazing landscapes, climb a mountain and even look at real volcanoes! Sounds inspiring? But what if you can do all this right now, just by watching this episode? Will the adventures of our heroes inspire you? Let's see!

videos.title: What's Inside
videos.overview: What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order? In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure.

videos.title: The First Swallow
videos.overview: Do you know what ornithology is? This is a science that studies birds! And it is also Dasha's new hobby. She comes to visit Masha and the Bear and discovers a new unique bird species! What is this amazing unusual bird?

videos.title: Honey Day
videos.overview: Beekeeping is not easy. Especially when you have Masha for an assistant! However, you should not be afraid of bees, because with the right approach and knowledge of the matter, even the most seemingly dangerous insects become friends!

videos.title: Mushroom Rain
videos.overview: Autumn forest is so wonderful. You can pick mushrooms, listen to birds singing ... But what if there are absolutely no mushrooms at all? Masha finds an original solution to this problem. Which one? Watch the episode and find out!

videos.title: Tour de Forest
videos.overview: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

videos.title: Finders Keepers
videos.overview: What a great find in the forest! Masha has come across a real live hat! Is it worth saying how delighted the little mischievous girl is from all the wonders that are happening around her?

videos.title: Berry Naughty
videos.overview: Oh, what a ripe, sweet, and beautifully-smelling raspberry! Masha has gone picking berries, but Bear had strictly forbidden it. Now she'll do anything to avoid admitting that she disobeyed him.

videos.title: Mind your manners
videos.overview: Yay, it's Bear's birthday! Well, it might be a "hooray" for someone and may not be for someone else: the only thing Bear himself dreams of is that the day will be a relaxing one. But can his wish come true, when one of the guests is a restless Masha?

videos.title: Treasure Island
videos.overview: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

videos.title: Masha Knows Best
videos.overview: Masha is sure that she is the best nanny in the world because all children simply adore her! Could this actually be true?

videos.title: Who's the Boss?
videos.overview: Bear needs to step away for a while, leaving Masha, Panda, and Penguin alone at home. It seems to be a simple situation - something all adults can understand. But which of the children will be in charge?

videos.title: Wish Upon a Star
videos.overview: Wow, it's another New Year! Masha has a lot of experience in organizing unforgettable celebrations, so she take smatters into her own hands this time, too. Oh, and everyone in the forest will be dancing!

videos.title: Love is in the Bear
videos.overview: Ah, love, love! Bear prepares a gift for the Lady Bear and, as usual, dreams of winning his lady's heart. But Masha is also here! To what else, besides a total mess, will her interference in the affairs of the heart lead to?

videos.title: Pasta La Vista
videos.overview: Who is the best cook in all the forest?Masha has no doubts as to how to correctly answer this question. And the proof is right before you: macaroni cooked by Masha herself. What can be simpler? Only Dasha is somehow sure that Masha's final product is inedible. As usual, Bear will have to solve the girls' dispute, as usual.

videos.title: Awesome Blossoms
videos.overview: Bear has a new problem: his garden has been overtaken by dandelions! As Bear tries to fight against the weeds, Masha does not understand why he is picking flowers just to throw them away. After all, dandelions can be so beautiful!

videos.title: Sleeping Beauties
videos.overview: Masha is the best "mommy" in the world, but even she can not put Rosy to sleep. Bear offers a solution: a music box. And everything would have been fine, but the music box suddenly turns out to hold a surprise inside it!

videos.title: Try, try again
videos.overview: A van with Monkeys arrived at the Bear's house. They invite everyone to test themselves with the help of an attraction - a power meter. The Bear is confident that he will easily win the main prize. But things didn't go according to plan. And now the main strongman of the forest cannot do without the help of his friends.

videos.title: How to Train Your Plant
videos.overview: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher.  She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

videos.title: Bears were Riding
videos.overview: The Bear has a new acquisition: he decided to get a motorcycle! In the role of a cool biker, he is going to impress the Bear. But she doesn't seem to like skating very much. And the cheerful Masha, on the contrary, cannot be dragged away from the motorcycle. As always, everything goes somersaulting, and literally.

videos.title: UnBearable Beach
videos.overview: On a nice summer’s day Bear, as usual, goes fishing and Masha follows alongside. But the fishing trip didn’t quite work out: the forest dwellers made a “beach” at Bear’s favourite spot. Masha is glad to have the opportunity to swim, but the lifeguard is a little overzealous!

videos.title: Happily Feather After
videos.overview: Spring has come, the starlings have arrived! But a pigeon settles in the birdhouse near the Bear's house - and Masha, of course, is only happy to feed and caress him, making him her new pet. No matter how hard the Bear tries to evict the uninvited tenant, nothing works - the Pigeon returns back with the persistence of a boomerang. Whose victory will end this spring story?

videos.title: The Mystery Guest
videos.overview: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him.  Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

videos.title: Princess of Dragon?
videos.overview: A snow tower? Check. A group of friends? Check. Sound like a recipe for a fun game!Even Bear caved to the pressure and joined Masha, Rosie and Penguin – what wouldn’t you do for the sake of the children! But who will be the Princess? And who will be the Dragon? And the knight and his brave steed? Masha has her own opinion on these questions...

videos.title: When a Pig Flies
videos.overview: Rosie has lost her peace because of such appetizing and ripe acorns growing right above her little snout. To get the desired but inaccessible delicacy, she must jump above her head or simply learn how to fly. It's good there is Masha around, who knows for sure it is always useful to dream.

videos.title: All You Need is a Goal
videos.overview: The ball is on the field, the players are in the field, the Bear in the chair is rooting for his favorite team. But Masha got bored in anticipation of a goal. Why wait when there is a team in the yard, and everyone needs a goal so much!

videos.title: Soup Pursuit
videos.overview: The wolves are going to cook borscht under Masha's guidance. They have a cookbook, a big pot and a ravenous appetite. But they still gotta get the ingredients! It seems that the newly-minted culinary specialists will get something interesting going on.

videos.title: Who's Gifted?
videos.overview: Christmas is a time of miracles and gifts. All the inhabitants of the forest prepared performances for Santa Claus, but Masha was the best prepared. Does the good wizard have enough gifts for her?

videos.title: Arts and Crafts Day
videos.overview: Masha announces Arts and Crafts Day. Get your glue, pencils and any unnecessary things and let's create! The Bear is trying to sneak away on a fishing trip. But what will he catch if all his floats are gone for crafts? Is it Masha, to put her in a corner? Well, not this time. Friendship always wins in our creative contests!

videos.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
videos.overview: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

videos.title: Lucky Charms
videos.overview: How to give the Bear his good luck back? A horseshoe, a rabbit's foot, or a knock on wood can do the trick. Masha finds out empirically - if you have a small but faithful friend in a pink scarf, you won't need luck. Everything will turn out in the most successful way. During the experiment, no bear will be harmed. Almost.
